description: SMBus Alert Response Address (SMBALERT#). Source: SMBus Specification v3.3 (12 May 2024, SMIF) App. A.2 (Figs 65-66), §6.2.2.6, Table 17. Controller performs a modified Receive Byte; the lowest-address alerting device wins arbitration and returns its 7-bit address in [7:1] ([0] don't-care), optionally followed by PEC. A write to 0x0C is invalid per A.2/Table 17 (App. D states the opposite polarity; A.2 governs).
byte_order_note: Single-byte response; PEC byte (if any) trails and is ignored.

rules.name: Alert Response
rules.description: Modified Receive Byte (Fig 65/66). Repeat while SMBALERT# stays low.

fields.name: Alerting Device
fields.description: 7-bit address from [7:1]; bit 0 is X (either value).

rules.name: INVALID: write to ARA
rules.description: R/W#=0 to 0x0C is not permitted (A.2, Table 17 v3.3); targets should NACK. Also flags bus scans that probe 0x0C with a write.
